name: slop-gate
title: slop-gate vocabulary
description: Vocabulary tells from the slop-gate CLI, converted to this format with test examples added. Rules that duplicate the shipped sets (delve, tapestry, meticulous, pivotal, vibrant, bustling, nestled, testament, worth-noting) were left out. Literal spaces were replaced with \s+ throughout: the original patterns break on a double space or an  , which the fudger caught on 18 of 28 rules.

rules.name: leverage
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: leverage.
rules.suggest: Write "use".

hit: We leverage the cache to cut latency.
miss: The leverage ratio held through the quarter.

rules.name: navigate complexities
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: navigate complexities.
rules.suggest: Name the task: handle it, work through it.

hit: The team navigates the complexities of migration.
miss: We navigate the menu with arrow keys.

rules.name: fast paced world
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: fast paced world.
rules.suggest: Delete it and start with the subject.

hit: In today's fast-paced world, speed matters.
miss: In today's release we fixed the parser.

rules.name: comprehensive guide
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: comprehensive guide.
rules.suggest: Drop it. A good guide proves itself.

hit: This comprehensive guide covers deployment.
miss: The guide covers deployment.

rules.name: transformative
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: transformative.
rules.suggest: Show the change concretely.

hit: The release was transformative for the team.
miss: The transformation completed overnight.

rules.name: cutting edge
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: cutting edge.
rules.suggest: Say what is actually new.

hit: Our cutting edge platform ships today.
miss: The cutting tool was sharp.

rules.name: empower
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: empower.
rules.suggest: Say what it lets people do.

hit: The dashboard empowers teams to decide faster.
miss: Power was restored at noon.

rules.name: unlock value
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: unlock value.
rules.suggest: Say what becomes possible.

hit: This unlocks the value hidden in your logs.
miss: She unlocked the door at seven.

rules.name: harness
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: harness.
rules.suggest: Say what it uses and for what.

hit: We harness the power of the GPU.
miss: The horse harness needed repair.

rules.name: streamline
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: streamline.
rules.suggest: Say what was removed.

hit: The change streamlines onboarding.
miss: The stream lined up with the bank.

rules.name: proactive
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: proactive.
rules.suggest: Say what you do and when.

hit: We proactively monitor the queue.
miss: The reaction was immediate.

rules.name: feel free
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: feel free.
rules.suggest: Delete it. Just say the thing.

hit: Feel free to reach out with questions.
miss: The team felt free of the deadline.

rules.name: end of the day
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: end of the day.
rules.suggest: Cut it, or say what actually decides the matter.

hit: At the end of the day, latency is what users feel.
miss: The batch runs at the end of the day.
We reconcile the ledger at the end of the day and go home.

rules.note: narrowed to the sentence-initial discourse marker; the literal time of day is not a tell

rules.name: in conclusion
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: in conclusion.
rules.suggest: Delete it and write the conclusion.

hit: In conclusion, the migration succeeded.
miss: The conclusion of the proof follows.

rules.name: dive in
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: dive in.
rules.suggest: Start with the thing itself.

hit: Let's dive into the architecture.
miss: The diver went into the water.

rules.name: when it comes to
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: when it comes to.
rules.suggest: Name the subject directly.

hit: When it comes to latency, caching helps.
miss: The invoice comes to sixty euro.

rules.name: game changer
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: game changer.
rules.suggest: Say what changed and for whom.

hit: The new index is a game changer.
miss: The game changed at half time.

rules.name: top notch
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: top notch.
rules.suggest: Say what makes it good.

hit: The support team is top notch.
miss: The notch was cut at the top.

rules.name: treasure trove
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: treasure trove.
rules.suggest: Say what is in it.

hit: The logs are a treasure trove of detail.
miss: They found treasure in the wreck.

rules.name: embark on
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: embark on.
rules.suggest: Say what you are starting.

hit: We embark on a journey of migration.
miss: Passengers embark at gate four.

rules.name: foster a
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: foster a.
rules.suggest: Say what people actually do.

hit: The ritual fosters a culture of ownership.
miss: They foster two children.

rules.name: underscore importance
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: underscore importance.
rules.suggest: State the fact and let it carry itself.

hit: The outage underscores the importance of backups.
miss: Underscores separate the words.

rules.name: moreover
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: moreover.
rules.suggest: Join the sentences, or delete the connective.

hit: The build is faster. Moreover, it uses less memory.
miss: The moreover clause was struck.

rules.name: elevate
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: elevate.
rules.suggest: Say what improves and by how much.

hit: This elevates the customer experience.
miss: The elevator reached the top floor.
The elevator reached the top floor.

rules.name: robust
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: robust.
rules.suggest: Name the specific strength: what does it survive?

hit: We built a robust pipeline.
miss: Robustness was never the concern.

rules.note: single ordinary word; expect false positives in engineering prose

rules.name: crucial
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: crucial.
rules.suggest: Say why it matters, or drop the intensifier.

hit: Caching is crucial for latency.
miss: The crux of the argument is simpler.

rules.note: single ordinary word; expect false positives

rules.name: realm
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: realm.
rules.suggest: Name the field plainly.

hit: In the realm of distributed systems, clocks lie.
miss: The realm was ruled from the north.

rules.name: seamless
rules.description: Flagged by slop-gate as an AI-writing tell: seamless.
rules.suggest: Describe what works without friction.

hit: The migration was seamless.
miss: The seam was stitched by hand.
